body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG presented ‘AB110’, its home projector equipped with 16:9 wide panel for entertainment use during CES 2007. It features a brightness of 1,100 ANSI, SVGA resolution, and a contrast ratio of 2,500:1.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
